author: pmbGUNNER
text:
anudora wrote: My homework with more FL chart. Feel free to comment. Maybe the first chart not FTB but subsequent returns.

hi anudora glad to see you here your charts are great for beginning, i'm sure you will get the concept soon enough

about your first chart, yes, that's an FTB. by an "TB" we just mean a return to our zone and i think it's not important that the return is with several candle tests or just a spike to our level. the important thing about returns to FTRs or FLs is that the market mostly respects the zone at the first return and it would go to the last untested zone that market has made.

anyway i'm not an expert and this is just my point of view about FTBs. just wanted to share it with you mate. hope it helps keep up the good work man

GUNNER
